summary: A French-country farmhouse (two storeys, stone walls, steep gable roof, brick chimney, shuttered windows) with an adjoining potager kitchen garden (walled enclosure, raised beds, gravel paths, cold frame, tool shed, archway entrance, lanterns). Built using Grid-based block placement and the mcd roof cottage preset for the main structure; generator modules for house, chimney, porch, garden beds, structures, and details; all major elements visible and recognizable from multiple angles.
elements: Two-storey farmhouse: stone brick walls with chiseled trim floors
Steep gable roof: spruce-shingle palette via mcd roof preset
Brick chimney: red brick stack above roof peak
Shuttered windows: air blocks (trapdoors) on front/back, both storeys
Timber porch/lean-to: oak logs and slabs on garden side
Potager boundary wall: stone brick fence enclosure (rectangular)
Raised beds: dark oak fence borders with farmland/wheat blocks
Garden paths: gravel with light gray concrete cross pattern, center well (crafting table)
Cold frame: dark oak frame with glass pane roof
Tool shed: small oak structure with door
Arch entrance: fence gates connecting house to garden
Lanterns: corner posts and gate markers for lighting
Fruit trees: oak logs with leaves trained against east wall
Potted flowers: decorative mushroom pots on support blocks
Overall layout: 40×36 footprint, ~20 blocks tall, complete complex visible
polish: Window shutters could show realistic half-open state (trapdoor facing/half properties)
Potager crop variety: currently wheat only, should alternate carrots/potatoes/beetroots per bed
Cold frame could be taller/more detailed with frame structure
Tool shed interior: bare walls, could add shelving/tools
Fruit trees: small but readable, could expand growth
Chimney: functional but minimal texture, could alternate brick types
Porch roof: simple slabs, could add rafters/overhang details
Ground textures: flat farmland, could add grass/dirt/gravel variety
Bean/rose arch: gates only, no actual bean/rose vegetation shown
